name: tax-regime-compare
title: Tax Regime Compare
description: Old vs new regime tax for salaried residents in India, tax year 2026-27, from salary, HRA (50% cities per rule 279), 80C, 80D, NPS and home-loan interest. Shows break-even deductions and flags a costlier choice, deductions the new regime ignores and over-limit claims.

meta.summary: Compares India's old and new income-tax regimes for a salaried person and flags a choice that costs more or deductions that don't count.
catches: The regime that costs more for these inputs

HRA at 50% of salary in the eight listed cities, 40% elsewhere

rules.note: Confirmed: no change in s.202 rates for tax year 2026-27; new-regime slabs 0–4L nil … above 24L 30%; rebate ₹60,000 up to ₹12 lakh (new) and ₹12,500 up to ₹5 lakh (old); 80C ₹1.5 lakh, 80D ₹25,000/₹50,000, 80CCD(1B) ₹50,000; HRA 50% for Mumbai, Kolkata, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru. Standard deduction (₹75,000/₹50,000) and the ₹2 lakh home-loan limit were not re-checked on a primary page. Informational; verify with the official source or a professional.
